```{r Import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
source("code/ggplot_themes.R")
```

```{r Import data}
kw_comparisons <- read_csv("output/corpus_comparisons/pairs.csv")
kw_comparisons$title <- gsub("\\([^)]*\\)|\\.txt","",kw_comparisons$topic)
kw_comparisons$title <- gsub("_", " ", kw_comparisons$title)

```

```{r Plotting}
# Try a simple bar plot for each difference
ggplot(data=kw_comparisons) +
  geom_col(aes(
    x=reorder(title,-genetics_diff_b_minus_a), 
    y=genetics_diff_b_minus_a, 
    fill=genetics_diff_b_minus_a>0
    ),
    width=1,
    color="grey80",
    linewidth=0.05) +
  theme_endline() +
  theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
  )  +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      rcartocolor::carto_pal(
        n    = 2,
        name = "Bold"
      )
    )
  ) + 
  xlab("Page") + ylab("More genetics keywords in: \n \u2190 Wikipedia        Grokipedia \u2192                              ")

#+ 
  #scale_fill_manual(values=c("#458B74","#7D26CD"))
```


```{r Genetics sections differences}

out_dir <- "figures"

genetics_sections <- read.csv("output/corpus_comparisons/genetics_sections/genetics_sections.csv")

df <- genetics_sections %>%
  mutate(
    label = gsub("\\([^)]*\\)|\\.txt", "", page),
    label = gsub("_", " ", label),
    label = trimws(label)
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diff = wiki_length - grok_length,
    group = case_when(
      wiki_length > 0 & grok_length > 0 ~ 1,
      grok_length > 0 & wiki_length == 0 ~ 2,
      wiki_length > 0 & grok_length == 0 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 4
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, diff) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label))

ggplot(df, aes(x = label, y = -diff, fill = factor(group))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#4477AA", "2" = "#CC6677", "3" = "#228833"),
                    labels = c("Both projects","Grokipedia only","Wikipedia only")) +
  labs(
    x = "Page name",
    y = "Grokipedia length minus Wikipedia length",
    title = "Differences in Grokipedia and Wikipedia genetics section lengths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Project:"))

#ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "grokipedia_wikipedia_section_lengths.svg"),
#       width=10,height=6,dpi=300,device="svg")

# The reason Wikipedia sections can be longer but have fewer genetics keywords is because they can contain, e.g., lengthy excerpts, extensive methodological details, or quotes from researchers


```

```{r Genetics sections histograms}
genetics_sections <- read.csv("output/corpus_comparisons/genetics_sections/genetics_sections.csv")

# Might want this for histograms
max_length <- plyr::round_any(max(c(genetics_sections$wiki_length, genetics_sections$grok_length)),1000,f=ceiling)

# Convert to long format
df_long <- genetics_sections %>%
  select(page, wiki_length, grok_length) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(wiki_length, grok_length), names_to = "source", values_to = "length")

# Plot histogram
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = length, fill = source)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) +
  labs(x = "Length", y = "Count", fill = "Source") +
  theme_endline() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      rcartocolor::carto_pal(
        n    = 2,
        name = "Bold"
      )
    ),
    labels = c("Wikipedia","Grokipedia")
  ) +
  ggtitle("Lengths of genetics sections") + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Project"))
  #theme(legend.position="none")
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("wiki_length" = "#4477AA", "grok_length" = "#CC6677"))
```

```{r Comparing keyword counts}

kw_counts_file <- "output/corpus_comparisons/plaintext_keyword_counts.csv"
kw_counts <- read.csv(kw_counts_file)

out_dir <- "figures"

w_ <- 10
h_ <- 6
dev_ <- "png"
dpi_ <- 300

# Get total counts by project by page
# Drop some variables to avoid double-counting
drop_vars <- c("mt-DNA","y-DNA","x chromosom","y chromosom")
drop_pages <- c("Black_people","White_people","Ashkenazi_Jews")
kw_counts_total <- kw_counts %>%
  filter(!(keyword %in% drop_vars) & !(page_name %in% drop_pages)) %>%
  aggregate(count ~ project + page_name, FUN="sum")
#kw_counts_totle <- kw_counts_total%>%
  

# Calculate differences
df_wide <- kw_counts_total %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = project, values_from = count) %>%
  mutate(grok_minus_wiki = Grokipedia - Wikipedia) %>%
  select(page_name, count = Grokipedia, grok_minus_wiki) %>%
  arrange(grok_minus_wiki)

ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = fct_reorder(gsub("_", " ", page_name), grok_minus_wiki),
                    y = grok_minus_wiki)) + 
  geom_col(fill="#4477AA") + 
  labs(
    x = "Page name",
    y = "Grokipedia keywords minus Wikipedia keywords\n
    ←More on Wikipedia            More on Grokipedia→",
    title = "Genetics keywords on Grokipedia versus Wikipedia"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6))

#ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("grokipedia_wikipedia_kw_count_diffs.", dev_)),
#       width=w_, height=h_, dpi=dpi_, device=dev_)

```

```{r Some summary stats of Grokipedia vs Wikipedia differences}

# t-test of the number of keywords on pages
t.test(kw_counts_total %>% filter(project=="Grokipedia") %>% pull(count),
       kw_counts_total %>% filter(project=="Wikipedia") %>% pull(count), paired = TRUE)

# Odds ratio for the presence of keywords
kw_counts_total_wide <- kw_counts_total %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = project, values_from = count) %>%
  mutate(
    grok_nonzero = as.integer(Grokipedia != 0),
    wiki_nonzero = as.integer(Wikipedia != 0)
  )

contingency <- table(kw_counts_total_wide$grok_nonzero, kw_counts_total_wide$wiki_nonzero)
fisher.test(contingency)

# Odds ratio for the presence of sections
# Attach section lengths from the other data frame. Replace NAs with 0.
kw_counts_total_sections <- kw_counts_total_wide %>% select(-grok_nonzero, -wiki_nonzero) %>%
  left_join(genetics_sections, by=c("page_name"="page")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(
    grok_nonzero = as.integer(grok_length != 0),
    wiki_nonzero = as.integer(wiki_length != 0)
  )

contingency <- table(kw_counts_total_sections$grok_nonzero, kw_counts_total_sections$wiki_nonzero)
fisher.test(contingency)

```

```{r Same as above, but sorted with geographical categories}

# output parameters
w_ <- 10
h_ <- 6
dpi_ <- 300
dev_ <- "png"

genetics_sections <- read.csv("output/corpus_comparisons/genetics_sections/genetics_sections.csv")
geo_cats <- read_csv("metadata/geographical_regions.csv")

# Recode geography

geo_cats <- geo_cats %>%
  mutate(region2 = case_when(
    Region=="SOUTH CENTRAL ASIA" ~ "SC-ASIA",
    Region=="EUROPE" ~ "EUR",
    Region=="MIDDLE EAST NORTH AFRICA" ~ "MENA",
    Region=="WESTERN HEMISPHERE" ~ "AMR-CAR",
    Region=="EAST ASIA AND PACIFIC" ~ "E-ASIA-PAC",
    Region=="SOUTHERN AFRICA" ~ "S-AFR")
    )

df <- genetics_sections %>%
  mutate(
    label = gsub("\\([^)]*\\)|\\.txt", "", page),
    label = gsub("_", " ", label),
    label = trimws(label)
  ) %>%
  left_join(geo_cats, by=c("label"="Demonym"))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diff = wiki_length - grok_length,
    group = case_when(
      wiki_length > 0 & grok_length > 0 ~ 1,
      grok_length > 0 & wiki_length == 0 ~ 2,
      wiki_length > 0 & grok_length == 0 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 4
    )
  ) %>%
  #arrange(group, diff) %>%
  #arrange(region2, group, diff) %>%
  arrange(region2, diff) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label))

# Join geo regions

#ggplot(df, aes(x = label, y = -diff, fill = factor(group))) +
ggplot(df, aes(x = label, y = -diff, fill = factor(group))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#4477AA", "2" = "#CC6677", "3" = "#F2B701"),
                    labels = c("Both projects","Grokipedia only","Wikipedia only")) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 30.5, linetype="11") +
  annotate("text", x=50, y = 10000, label="EUR") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 72.5, linetype="11") +
  annotate("text", x=77, y = 10000, label="MENA") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 84.5, linetype="11") +
  annotate("text", x=87, y = 11000, label="SAFR") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 88.5, linetype="11") +
  annotate("text", x=92, y = 10000, label="SCAS") +
  labs(
    x = "Page name",
    y = "Grokipedia length minus Wikipedia length\n
    ←Longer on Wikipedia            Longer on Grokipedia→",

  ) +
```
